title: World peace through meditation —
intro1: In the ancient yuga cycle, time turns through four great ages. We live at the far edge of Kali — the age of conflict and restlessness — and every tradition that tells this story agrees on what comes next:
intro1Accent: Satya Yugam, the age of truth.
intro1Tail: A world where harmony is the norm, not the exception.

yugas.name: Satya
yugas.tag: the Golden Age — truth, harmony, meditation as the natural state

yugas.name: Treta
yugas.tag: the Silver Age — virtue begins to wane

yugas.name: Dvapara
yugas.tag: the Bronze Age — balance tips toward unrest

yugas.name: Kali
yugas.tag: the dark age of conflict — where we rise from, together

intro2: Science gives us the mechanism: when enough minds settle into stillness, the collective field shifts — calm spreads the way fear does, person to person. The golden age is not waited for.
goalLead: Our end goal: a minimum of
goalTail: — the critical mass of consciousness that tips the world into Satya Yugam.
